uncertainty_notes: The best clarification budget may vary by task type and user preference; the policy uses a conservative default that can be changed later.
Whether a question would materially change the result still requires local judgment.
limitation_notes: This change adds governance and prompting policy, not an automated dialog manager.
The policy does not prohibit asking more questions when the user explicitly requests a discovery interview or questionnaire.
